title: KinForm: Kinetics-Informed Feature Optimised Representation Models for Enzyme kcat and KM Prediction
description: KinForm is a research software repository for predicting enzyme kinetic parameters from protein sequence and substrate SMILES using protein language model embeddings, binding-site-aware pooling, dimensionality reduction, and tree-based machine learning models.
